4 اشحل فُلَانًا (assumed tropical:) He found the people reviling such a one, (K, TA,) and blaming him, and speaking evil of him behind his back, or in his absence, or otherwise. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, in the latter half of the paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
